Why still held: not a bypass (all three call sites exit 1 correctly; `--check` writes nothing), and the trigger premise is a hand-mangled generated artifact of a type the generator never writes — no user path reaches it today. The cost is one dumb error message out of four defect classes that otherwise speak. Restart condition: promote if any real corruption event lands on a shard file (making the message quality matter), or fold it into the next `spec-tooling` sweep card as a member line — it is exactly sweep-sized (fix A or B in the card's own words, one lib landing site).

本评论来自分诊座位 Routine（#5474 试点），不构成认领。
